components.name: X25519MLKEM768
components.description: Hybrid TLS 1.3 key exchange combiner: concatenates the X25519 ECDH shared secret and the ML-KEM-768 shared secret per draft-ietf-tls-hybrid-design, so the connection stays classically secure even if ML-KEM's novel security assumption is later broken, and post-quantum secure even if ECDH is broken by a future quantum computer.

components.name: ML-KEM-768
components.description: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (FIPS 203), NIST security category 3. Half of the hybrid X25519MLKEM768 TLS 1.3 key exchange group in this project's "after" configuration.
